name: media-studio
description: Local creative studio for all video and audio: briefings, training, explainers, talking-heads, animation, and live-product screencasts. Uses Local-AI. Replaces product-demo-studio as the public skill pack.

interface.shortDescription: Local video, audio, and animation from a concept, including live-product screencasts.
interface.longDescription: Single public video/audio studio. Writes a screenplay, directs the picture, generates owner or role voice through Local-AI, captures live product with Playwright when needed, and composes with Remotion, Recast, or FFmpeg. Live-product screencasts invoke the internal screencast engine; everything else stays here.
defaultPrompt: Turn this outline into a local briefing video with owner voice.
Produce a short training clip from these bullets.
Capture this product workflow as a screencast, then narrate it locally.
